$description: Approved asset manifest. Claude references images ONLY from this list, never invents or substitutes stock. A file in assets/ that is NOT listed here is not selectable, and that is intentional.

$labeling.key: Deterministic id. One entry per approved asset.
$labeling.rights: Unclear rights means NOT approved for publishing.

$rules.size: Every committed image under 5 MB. Opaque photos: JPEG q=96 4:4:4 at full resolution. Transparency stays PNG.
$rules.no_gradients: Hotelink has no texture set. Never substitute a gradient or generated texture.
$rules.no_recolor: Approved colour variants are separate real files. Never invert, filter, or recolour a logo, including partner logos.
$rules.rights: Unclear rights means NOT approved. A filename is not provenance.

usage.$rule: Match the piece's format first, then the slot. Use ONLY an asset listed for that slot.
